checklistGeneric: Approver sign-off captured with a named approver
Change logged with a ticket reference
checklistSpecific: Production change request approved in ServiceNow with a CAB reference
All upstream quality gates and non-prod test runs are green before approval
Rollback plan and runbook link attached to the change record
Dataset owner and steward confirmed assigned before promotion is granted

testing.expected: A change record for the ingestion pipeline exists in the Approved state with a CAB reference before deployment

checklistGeneric: Change logged with a ticket reference
Code merged via reviewed pull request
checklistSpecific: High-watermark / incremental key persists and advances only on a successful load
Re-running the extract produces no duplicate rows in the landing zone (idempotent)
Landing files written in Parquet/Delta with the expected partitioning layout
Extracted row count reconciles to the source watermark delta

testing.expected: Landing zone contains the incremental extract with a row count matching the source watermark delta

checklistGeneric: Code merged via reviewed pull request
Change logged with a ticket reference
checklistSpecific: CDC slot/offset persists and resumes cleanly after a connector restart
Source credentials stored in the secrets manager, not in connector config or code
Both backfill and incremental modes validated against source counts
Connector retry/backoff and dead-letter handling configured

testing.expected: Connector configuration in the repository contains no plaintext credentials; secrets are referenced by name only

checklistGeneric: Change logged with a ticket reference
Runbook updated with the new alert and response steps
checklistSpecific: Alert fires on load failure and on SLA-breach latency, verified with a forced failure
Alerts route to the correct on-call channel/pager with the right severity
Freshness and row-count anomaly thresholds configured per the source SLA
Each alert links back to the failing run and its runbook

testing.expected: An alert rule for the ingestion job exists and fired during a forced test failure

checklistGeneric: Design reviewed and approved by a named reviewer
Decision documented in the shared knowledge base
checklistSpecific: Batch vs micro-batch vs streaming choice justified against the source SLA
Target latency and refresh cadence documented and agreed with the consumer
Medallion landing to bronze to silver flow defined for the source
Design reviewed and approved by data architecture before build starts

testing.expected: An approved ingestion pattern design document exists for the source with the SLA-justified pattern choice

checklistGeneric: Change logged with a ticket reference
Access request approved before credentials are issued
checklistSpecific: Authenticated test connection to the source succeeds from the pipeline runtime
Credentials/keys stored in the secrets manager and rotated per policy
Connection encrypted in transit (TLS) with firewall/allow-list rules approved
Source system registered as a configuration item in the CMDB

testing.expected: A successful authenticated connection to the source is logged from the orchestrator runtime

checklistGeneric: Receiving team acknowledges the handoff on the ticket
Runbook updated and linked from the handoff record
checklistSpecific: Runbook published with restart, backfill, and escalation steps
On-call rotation and alert routing confirmed with operations
Operations acknowledges the handoff and the agreed SLOs in the ticket
Known issues and manual steps documented for support

testing.expected: A published runbook for the pipeline exists and is linked from the operations handoff ticket

checklistGeneric: Code merged via reviewed pull request
Change logged with a ticket reference
checklistSpecific: Incoming records validated against the registered schema / data contract
Nonconforming rows rejected or routed to a quarantine/dead-letter table
Additive schema changes handled without breaking the load; breaking changes raise an alert
Rejected-record count and reason are logged and observable

testing.expected: Nonconforming test records land in the quarantine/reject table instead of the target table

checklistGeneric: Run health recorded against the change/ticket reference
Issues raised as tickets with severity
checklistSpecific: First production runs reviewed for status, duration, and row counts
Any errors or retries triaged and logged with a ticket
Latency and freshness within the agreed SLA on the initial runs
Run health recorded in the pipeline dashboard/log

testing.expected: Initial production run records for the pipeline are visible with success status and durations within SLA

checklistGeneric: Profiling summary documented in the shared knowledge base
Findings shared with the requester
checklistSpecific: Column-level profile captured: data types, null rates, cardinality, min/max
Volume and arrival cadence measured for sizing and SLA planning
Candidate PII / sensitive fields flagged for classification
Profiling summary documented and shared with the requesting team

testing.expected: A profiling summary for the source exists with null-rate, cardinality, and volume statistics

checklistGeneric: Deployment approved and logged with a change reference
Code merged via reviewed pull request
checklistSpecific: Deployment runs only after CI checks and quality gates pass
Pipeline artifact versioned and tagged in the repository
Infrastructure and config applied via IaC with no manual production changes
Post-deploy smoke run confirms the pipeline executes in production

testing.expected: A successful production deployment workflow run for the pipeline exists with all gates passed

checklistGeneric: Catalog entry reviewed and approved by the steward
Ownership recorded against the dataset record
checklistSpecific: Dataset entry created in the catalog with technical and business metadata
Named owner and steward assigned on the catalog entry
Classification and refresh frequency recorded on the entry
Upstream lineage from source to registered dataset captured

testing.expected: The ingested dataset appears in the catalog with an assigned owner and steward and captured lineage

checklistGeneric: Schedule change merged via reviewed pull request
Change logged with a ticket reference
checklistSpecific: Job scheduled at the agreed cadence in the orchestrator
Schedule defined as code and version-controlled
Dependencies/sensors set so the job waits for upstream readiness
Catch-up/backfill behavior and SLA timeout configured

testing.expected: The ingestion DAG/job is registered and enabled at the agreed cadence in the orchestrator

checklistGeneric: Test results recorded against the ticket reference
Code merged via reviewed pull request
checklistSpecific: End-to-end run in non-prod with representative data completes successfully
Output row counts and key fields reconcile to the source
Re-run confirms idempotency with no duplicate rows
Failure and retry paths exercised with negative test cases

testing.expected: A successful end-to-end non-prod pipeline run with passing validations is recorded

checklistGeneric: Request logged with a ticket reference
Feasibility decision recorded on the ticket
checklistSpecific: Request logged with source system, requesting owner, and business purpose
Source connectivity method and access path assessed for feasibility
Data contract / expected schema reviewed with the requester
Feasibility decision and next step recorded on the ticket

testing.expected: The ingestion request is logged with source details and a recorded feasibility assessment

checklistGeneric: Change logged with a ticket reference
Code merged via reviewed pull request
checklistSpecific: Bottleneck identified from run metrics and addressed (partitioning/parallelism)
Retry, backoff, and dead-letter handling tuned for transient failures
Run duration meets the SLA after tuning
Changes validated against a representative production-scale load

testing.expected: Post-tuning run duration and error-rate metrics meet the target SLA

checklistGeneric: Validation result recorded against the acceptance criteria
Sign-off captured on pass/fail
checklistSpecific: Completeness checked against expected volume and meets the acceptance threshold
End-to-end latency measured and within the agreed SLA
Key and reference integrity validated on the ingested data
Validation result recorded as pass against the documented criteria

testing.expected: Validation results show completeness and latency meeting the defined acceptance criteria
